name: paseo-cto
description: Lean, provider-neutral, release-driven CTO operating model for Claude Code and Codex: delegate bounded outcomes to isolated Paseo agents, inspect by risk under a charter-chosen review floor, ration validation, context and reporting, integrate only source-linked evidence, and report in the project-configured language. Models and effort remain owner decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Run a release-driven Paseo engineering organization
interface.longDescription: Operate the same CTO-led Paseo organization in Codex or Claude. The CTO keeps the nearest shippable outcome and critical path explicit, delegates bounded work to isolated agents, inspects Routine work itself and delegates Significant and Critical review by the charter's floor, rations validation, context and heartbeat cost, and integrates only source-linked durable evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $paseo-cto:paseo-cto to advance the nearest shippable product outcome, reconcile the fleet, and keep the living plan current.
